profile.headline: Full Stack Software Dev @ Lennar | Prev. SDE Intern @ Amazon | Dartmouth '24
profile.summary: I graduated Magna Cum Laude from Dartmouth College with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science. I'm now a Full Stack Software Developer based in Miami, building web applications and internal tools.

positions.title: Strategic Planning Student Director, First Generation Office
positions.description:
•	Collected and maintained financial and academic resources for over 300 first-generation students.
•	Planned and organized student workshops and tutoring services for upwards of 100 students.

positions.title: Endowment Fellow, Investment Office
positions.description:
• Participated in a fellowship program for a comprehensive introduction to investing, with a focus on  Dartmouth's $8+ Billion endowment portfolio
• Collaborated with a team to conduct a case study, simulating the due diligence process undertaken by investment managers

positions.title: Teaching Assistant, Department of Computer Science
positions.description:
•	Teaching Assistant for COSC21: Foundations of Digital Design
•	Guided over 25 students through Adobe Photoshop during class and weekly office hours. 
•	Graded student projects based on a set of technical and aesthetic criteria.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed and implemented an automated Alexa integration test suite using Internal Alexa Test SDK to emulate Alexa requests, covering various Voice User Interface (VUI) utterances and scenarios.
• Integrated the created test suite into the team’s pipeline using the Hydra Test platform, contributing to the transformation of the pipeline into a fully automated CI/CD process, ensuring efficient and reliable software releases.
• Practiced agile software development by participating in daily sprints and stand-ups and organized my work with supporting tools like Git, CRUX for code reviews, and Jira for project tracking.
positions.insights: Test Automation, Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) and +7 skills

positions.title: UI/UX Intern
positions.description:
• Redesigned 10+ internal admin tools, employing principles of human-centered design to enhance usability and accessibility.
• Conducted Figma training sessions for 10+ team members, improving their design collaboration and proficiency.
• Designed multiple website pages adhering to new brand guidelines, with several pages successfully launched into production.

honors.title: College Honor List
honors.description: In recognition of outstanding academic performance during the 2023-2024 year. Placed on the College Honor List in the Third Honor Group, indicating standing is in the top 15 percent of all students

projects.title: Guided Maps
projects.description: Used Claude Code to build and ship a curated map-based guide iOS app, using React Native and TypeScript with a Supabase backend for the database, authentication, real-time sync, and cloud storage.

projects.title: Part-of-Speech Tagger
projects.description:
• Designed a program utilizing a hidden Markov model and the Viterbi algorithm to accurately assign parts of speech to words. 
• Achieved with dictionaries and binary trees, and trained the algorithm using extensive data sets of up to one million words.
